profile.time_semantics: inclusive sums are work, not elapsed wall time; self subtracts child union

coverage_gaps: state ownership covers directly observed AF_INET/AF_INET6 TCP bind/connect/accept operations only
accepted sockets receive a post-do_accept snapshot; TCP transitions before ownership publication are not claimed
owners still present after the producer barrier are retired from attribution; retirement is counted separately and is never projected as an observed TCP DESTROY event
UDP, Unix-domain, raw, packet, inherited, SCM_RIGHTS, io_uring, and delegated sockets are explicitly outside this partial state contract
native syscall ABI only; compat/x32 calls are not reliably classified
successful operation results are not proof that durable state differs
MAP_SHARED memory writes are not observed after the mapping is established
io_uring requests and completions are not decoded or causally joined
namespace creation through clone/clone3 is not recorded by this syscall-pair sensor
kernel-worker, writeback, softirq, and delayed async effects are not causally attributed
exact cgroup attribution identifies an unclassified run-execution-domain caller; it does not identify Agent code or observe delegated effects
netlink and generic ioctl payload semantics are not decoded
cooperative controlled workloads only; a privileged adversarial workload can evade the exact cgroup or tamper with enumerable BPF maps

KERNEL_OBJECT_EXPANDED resolves successful selected ordinary opens to the final user-visible file through file_post_open after filesystem callbacks complete (including stackable-filesystem opens), create parent directories, hard-link source inodes in the destination mount, unlink/rmdir targets, chmod/chown targets (including fchmodat2), mountless xattr inodes with bounded attribute-name capture, rename sources, eligible file-backed MAP_SHARED+PROT_WRITE mmap targets, and single shared file-backed VMA mprotect(PROT_WRITE) requests; it also resolves bind/connect requested socket endpoints, successful accept/accept4 accepted-socket peers, and a separately verified AF_INET/AF_INET6 TCP accept/transition/destroy stream. O_PATH/O_TMPFILE, missing or duplicate post-open joins, hard-link destination children, rename destinations, other created children, actual dirty-page writes after mmap/mprotect, multi-VMA or anonymous/private mprotect targets, non-INET/TCP socket state, io_uring, SCM_RIGHTS provenance, and delegated effects remain explicitly outside this partial contract

process-lifecycle schema v2 has no authoritative S0 task/thread enrollment ledger and no cgroup migration or CLONE_INTO_CGROUP enrollment hook; EXEC/EXIT may introduce identities during replay, so whole-tree lifecycle association is PARTIAL
FD object identity remains unresolved for truncate, setattr, allocation, range-transfer, sync, mmap, ioctl, and other non-write FD operations
balanced profile omits mmap/mprotect, fsync, ioctl, prctl, and setsockopt events

limitations: process-lifecycle schema v2 has no authoritative S0 task/thread enrollment ledger and no cgroup migration or CLONE_INTO_CGROUP enrollment hook; EXEC/EXIT may introduce identities during replay, so whole-tree lifecycle association is PARTIAL
EXEC filename is a bounded kernel-copied description, not executable FILE_OBJECT identity
direct exact-cgroup lifecycle attribution does not establish delegated causality
lossless terminal WAL replay applies only to lifecycle events admitted by the three scheduler hooks
